					 Assessing 
Disclaimer and general information about accessing Town of Hollis assessing records. 
					 Building / Code Enforcement 
Information on Hollis building permits, inspections, code compliance, and zoning enforcement, including application procedures, complaint submissions, and links to archived permits. 
					 Communications Center 
This page lists the staff of the Communications Center and images related to the Communications Center. 
					 Emergency Management 
The Genasys GEM Alert System will be used to send emergency notifications. 
					 Finance Department 
The Finance Department manages the Town of Hollis’s budgeting, accounting, and financial operations, ensuring accurate records, compliance with regulations, and responsible use of public funds. 
					 Fire Department 
This page provides daily fire danger updates, burn permit information, weather conditions, fire safety rules, department contacts, and staff details. 
					 Health Department 
This page allows users to contact the Health Department by sending a message directly to the Health Officer. 
					 Human Resources 
This page lists the subpages of Human Resources and the contact information of the Human Resources department. 
					 Library 
Visit the Hollis Social Library Website on this page. 
					 Planning Department 
This page provides access to Planning Board meeting minutes and agendas, along with staff contacts. 
					 Police 
This page provides access to the Hollis Police Department’s arrest logs and press logs, along with a link to their Twitter page and contact information for department staff. 
					 Public Works 
Information about Public Works services, including maintenance of roads, facilities, and infrastructure to support community safety and quality of life. 
					 Recreation 
Information on local recreation programs, events, and facilities that promote community engagement, wellness, and active lifestyles. 
					 Schools 
Information about local schools, including educational programs, resources, and community partnerships that support student learning and development. 
					 Tax Collector 
This page provides the current tax rate, equalization rate, tax rate breakdown for 2024, and staff contact information for the Tax Collector’s office. 
					 Town Clerk 
The Hollis, NH Town Clerk manages elections, vital records, licensing, and the preservation of official town documents 
					 Welfare / Community Assistance 
Hollis, NH Welfare and Community Assistance programs provide support and resources to residents in need.
